description:
Import up to 500 time entries in one call, e.g. the Productive history. Managers only. Each entry: date (YYYY-MM-DD), person (email or user id; must be an @seoalive.com member of the organization), hours (exact decimal, 0.1 = 6 minutes, never rounded), and the service as serviceId (a service id from list_time_tracker_projects) or as project + budget + service names (exact, case-insensitive); optional note, taskId (a task id of this organization) and externalId. dryRun defaults to true: nothing is saved and every row is reported as would_create or rejected with its reason. Pass dryRun: false to save. Idempotent: an entry already imported under the same externalId (or the same person, service, date, hours and note, counted per occurrence) is reported as skipped_existing, so re-running a file creates no duplicates. Rejected rows never block the others. Only @seoalive.com accounts can use the time tracking tools.

Cost: 5 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// preview an import of one entry; nothing is saved.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","entries":[{"date":"2026-10-05","person":"teammate@seoalive.com","project":"Acme","budget":"October retainer","service":"SEO","hours":"0.1","note":"Check redirects","externalId":"productive-123"}],"dryRun":true}
```
name: bulk_create_time_entries
